title: Onboarding sync with side talk
covers: joking "decisions" that the meeting did not make
a due date said twice by different people

segments.speaker: Avery Example
segments.text: Before we start, did anyone watch the match last night?

segments.speaker: Blake Example
segments.text: Don't remind me. We should decide to never schedule standups after a match day, ha.

segments.speaker: Drew Example
segments.text: I vote we order pizza every Friday forever.

segments.speaker: Avery Example
segments.text: Ha, noted. Okay, the onboarding flow.

segments.speaker: Blake Example
segments.text: The new signup form drops about a third of users at the company size step.

segments.speaker: Drew Example
segments.text: Then let's remove the company size field from signup and ask for it later in settings.

segments.speaker: Avery Example
segments.text: Yes, decided. Company size moves out of signup.

segments.speaker: Blake Example
segments.text: My coffee machine is broken again, by the way.

segments.speaker: Drew Example
segments.text: Mine too, they must be on strike.

segments.speaker: Avery Example
segments.text: Drew, can you ship the shorter signup form by next Tuesday?

segments.speaker: Blake Example
segments.text: Also I'm thinking about adopting a cat.

segments.speaker: Avery Example
segments.text: Good luck with that. Last thing, the welcome email copy still says beta.

segments.speaker: Blake Example
segments.text: I'll fix the welcome email copy today.

decisions.text: Remove the company size field from signup and ask for it later in settings.

expected.text: ONB-3 Shorter signup form is in the backlog with no owner yet.
